Steps:

2. Define abdominal obesity:
   - Men: waist ≥ 102 cm

import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv("data.csv")

# Filter age 30-44
df = data[(data["RIDAGEYR"] >= 30) & (data["RIDAGEYR"] <= 44)].copy()

# Define abdominal obesity
df["ab_obese"] = (
    ((df["RIAGENDR"] == 1) & (df["BMXWAIST"] >= 102)) |
    ((df["RIAGENDR"] == 2) & (df["BMXWAIST"] >= 88))
)

# Weighted proportion using WTMEC2YR
num = df.loc[df["ab_obese"], "WTMEC2YR"].sum()
den = df["WTMEC2YR"].sum()
prop = num / den
prop
